purpose: Mechanism D exploratory test: RETRIEVAL_CONFIDENCE_SIGNAL, a score-margin-based uncertainty flag using Mem0's own retrieval scores.
excludes_note: all 28 units used anywhere in this arena to date (original 10 + Stage2's 10 + RAW_PROVENANCE fresh-replication's 8). _abs variants also excluded.

inputs_never_used: retrieval scores for these specific units
selection_rule.method: deterministic category quota (2 multi-session, 1 temporal-reasoning, 1 knowledge-update, 1 single-session-user -- 5 total, exploratory sizing per the campaign's <$0.30-preferred budget), first-by-question_id-sort within category after exclusion.
selection_rule.size_note: kept smaller than RAW_PROVENANCE's fresh-replication (8 units) because this is the EXPLORATORY stage for a new mechanism (contract preference <$0.30), not yet a replication -- a larger fresh sample is reserved for a later replication stage only if this exploratory test succeeds.

threshold_calibration.note: MARGIN_THRESHOLD=0.10 (scripts/arena/retrieval_confidence_signal.py) was chosen from the natural spread of already-collected, already-paid-for retrieval scores on the 8 RAW_PROVENANCE fresh-replication units (range ~0.025-0.34, inspected via a zero-cost Memory.search() call against the already-persisted store -- search makes no LLM call) -- a round, non-degenerate cutpoint chosen BEFORE this mechanism's own probe set was selected, not fit to this experiment's own results.
threshold_calibration.reused_units_not_retested: the 8 units used for threshold calibration are NOT reused in this experiment's own probe set -- they were already read/analyzed in depth for RAW_PROVENANCE and are excluded above.
